headline: Dolat Capital issues buy ratings for TCS and LTIMindtree
hook: Dolat Capital bullish on select IT stocks
summary: Dolat Capital has issued buy recommendations for TCS and LTIMindtree ahead of the Q2 earnings season. The brokerage notes that concerns surrounding artificial intelligence adoption are beginning to ease. This outlook follows a mixed performance across the Indian IT sector during the first quarter. Investors are evaluating these picks as the industry prepares to report its latest quarterly financial results.
whats_next: Q2 earnings announcements for the IT sector
why_it_matters: Brokerage sentiment may influence short-term price action for these IT majors.
winners_losers: TCS and LTIMindtree gain / Sector peers neutral

headline: LTM expands collaboration with Google Cloud for Gemini adoption
hook: LTM deepens partnership with Google Cloud
summary: LTM Limited announced an expanded partnership with Google Cloud on October 7, 2026. The collaboration focuses on accelerating the enterprise-wide adoption of Google's Gemini AI models. This initiative aims to help LTM's clients scale their generative AI capabilities. The move is part of the company's broader strategy to integrate advanced cloud and AI solutions into its service offerings.
why_it_matters: AI service expansion could boost long-term margins for LTM
winners_losers: LTM gains / Competitors face increased AI pressure

headline: Anand Rathi forecasts muted Q2 growth for IT sector
hook: Modest seasonal uptick expected for Indian IT
summary: Anand Rathi anticipates a modest seasonal quarter-on-quarter growth for Indian IT companies in Q2 FY27. The brokerage notes that demand revival remains absent, though current valuations appear attractive. Tech Mahindra and LTIMindtree are highlighted as top picks within the sector. Retail investors should note that the sector is currently driven by valuation comfort rather than strong fundamental demand growth.
whats_next: Q2 FY27 earnings announcements starting October 2026
why_it_matters: Expect limited upside for IT stocks due to sluggish demand.
winners_losers: Tech Mahindra and LTIMindtree gain favor
